android_mechanism: Per-row metadata recomputed on every access; fix computes it once
bug_description: The listening-history page stores each entry as a JSON string and calls JSON.parse(item) four times per row inside the build (cover image URL, name, creator, and click params). Every render of the history list re-parses every entry's JSON four times, wasting UI-thread CPU and growing linearly with history length (plus re-parses on every list mutation).
fix_summary: The item list is mapped to parsed objects once per render and rows read the parsed fields; deletion re-serializes only the affected entry.
trigger_steps: Play 30+ different tracks to populate listening history.
Start hitrace capture (categories: ace, app, sched).
Open the history page (历史记录) and scroll through all entries; delete one entry.
Stop hitrace. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: UI-thread CPU time from page-show to last row rendered plus the re-render after one deletion, from the ace trace.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed performs 4*history_size JSON.parse calls per render (visible in JS sampling); fixed performs history_size parses. unfixed_render_cpu_ms > fixed by >= 25% with 30+ entries.

oracle_revision.previous_comparison: unfixed performs 4*history_size JSON.parse calls per render (visible in JS sampling); fixed performs history_size parses.
oracle_revision.corrected_comparison: unfixed performs 3*history_size JSON.parse calls per render; fixed performs history_size parses. Measured: 600 vs 200 for a 200-entry list.
oracle_revision.reason: The page has four JSON.parse call sites, but only three run during a render: Image(JSON.parse(item).img), Text(JSON.parse(item).name) and Text(JSON.parse(item).creator). The fourth sits inside the row's onClick handler and only fires on a tap, which this bench never performs. Measured on device: unfixed 600 parses (200 x 3), fixed 200 (200 x 1). The claim's direction is unchanged.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 15 ace app sched -o /data/local/tmp/yt_histjson.chtrace
